item.title: How AI could bring Mayo-quality health care to everyone
item.description: The author shares a personal story about his wife's chronic conditions and envisions AI expanding access to top-tier medical expertise.

item.title: College no longer holds a monopoly on the American Dream
item.description: The college diploma is facing renewed scrutiny, whether displayed, stored, or still aspired to. This shift has significant implications.

item.title: AI prompts college students to reconsider their majors
item.description: Students and parents are seeking majors that remain relevant in an AI-driven world, as the job market evolves.

item.title: Luigi Mangione admits to killing UnitedHealthcare CEO, pleads guilty to stalking
item.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty in federal court to stalking charges related to the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.
